explanation: At around 70 beats a minute, a heart beats about 100,000 times a day, which adds up to roughly 2.5 billion beats over 70 years.

claims.text: A typical adult heart beats roughly 100,000 times a day.
A typical heart beats far more than 1,000 or 10,000 times a day and far fewer than 1,000,000.
A typical adult resting heart rate is around 60 to 100 beats a minute, often about 70.
At 70 beats a minute a heart beats about 100,800 times a day, and roughly 2.5 billion times in 70 years.
